questions.question_english: 60. Which of the following options represents the correct order of health facilities in the healthcare delivery hierarchy from the lowest level to the highest level?
options_english: Sub-Centre / Ayushman Arogya Mandir → Primary Health Centre (PHC) → Community Health Centre (CHC) → District Hospital

Primary Health Centre (PHC) → Sub-Centre → District Hospital → Community Health Centre (CHC)
Community Health Centre (CHC) → Primary Health Centre (PHC) → Sub-Centre → District Hospital
questions.explanation_english: The correct order of health facilities in the healthcare delivery hierarchy from the lowest level to the highest level is: Sub-Centre / Ayushman Arogya Mandir → Primary Health Centre (PHC) → Community Health Centre (CHC) → District Hospital. Public healthcare delivery in India is structured in a multi-tiered hierarchy. At the peripheral level, Sub-Centres and Ayushman Arogya Mandirs provide primary healthcare interventions. These refer patients to Primary Health Centres, which link to Community Health Centres serving as first referral units. District Hospitals occupy the highest level among secondary facilities, offering comprehensive specialty care and advanced medical treatment.

10. Given below are two statements: one is labelled Assertion (A) and the other is labelled Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) is implemented solely by the Ministry of Finance without participation from other ministries.
Reason (R): Declining Child Sex Ratio (0-6 years) reflects critical gender-based discrimination and sex-selective elimination.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.
questions.explanation_english: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao is executed as a multisectoral initiative jointly coordinated by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, Health and Family Welfare, and Education, making single-ministry claims inaccurate. Meanwhile, the declining child sex ratio in the zero to six years age group reflects gender bias and sex selective practices, underscoring the necessity of targeted awareness and regulatory enforcement across all regions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। बेटी बचाओ बेटी पढ़ाओ योजना एक बहु-क्षेत्रीय पहल के रूप में कार्यान्वित की जाती है, जिसे महिला एवं बाल विकास, स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण, और शिक्षा मंत्रालयों द्वारा संयुक्त रूप से समन्वयित किया जाता है, जिससे एकल मंत्रालय के दावों को गलत साबित करता है। इस बीच, 0 से 6 वर्ष की आयु वर्ग में घटता बाल लिंगानुपात लिंग पूर्वाग्रह और लिंग-चयनात्मक प्रथाओं को दर्शाता है, जो सभी क्षेत्रों में लक्षित जागरूकता और नियामक प्रवर्तन की आवश्यकता को उजागर करता है।

questions.question_english: 56. The scheme that offers cash assistance of Rs. 20,000 to a BPL household in the event of the natural or accidental death of the primary breadwinner aged between 18 and 59 years is known as:

Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)

questions.explanation_english: The National Family Benefit Scheme, a crucial component of the National Social Assistance Programme, provides a one-time lump sum grant of twenty thousand rupees to a below poverty line household upon the natural or accidental death of its primary breadwinner. The eligible age range for the deceased breadwinner is eighteen to fifty-nine years, which helps mitigate immediate distress for vulnerable families.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। राष्ट्रीय परिवार लाभ योजना, राष्ट्रीय सामाजिक सहायता कार्यक्रम का एक महत्वपूर्ण घटक है, जो बीपीएल परिवार को उसके प्राथमिक कमाने वाले की प्राकृतिक या आकस्मिक मृत्यु पर बीस हजार रुपये की एकमुश्त अनुदान प्रदान करती है। मृतक कमाने वाले की पात्रता आयु सीमा अठारह से उनसठ वर्ष है, जो कमजोर परिवारों के लिए तात्कालिक संकट को कम करने में मदद करती है।
